claims.claim: The camera is working perfectly fine
claims.evidence: No power-on, shutter fire, or live-view photo/video provided; witness only saw a static body with caps on.

claims.claim: Selling with 2 batteries and a silicone case
claims.evidence: Neither batteries nor a case appear in either photo; only the body, rear cap, and box are shown.
No photo of the camera's shutter-count menu screen or EXIF data from a test shot.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Witness report shows no lens attached in either photo (rear cap/mount cap only), so no lens is evidenced to exist in this listing.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired
claims.evidence: No battery, charger, or internal service sticker/screw visible in the photos.

risks.risk: Actual shutter actuation count may be much higher than claimed
risks.proof: Photo of the in-camera shutter count menu or a test-shot EXIF data screenshot

risks.risk: Sensor may have dust, scratches, or fungus
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the sensor with body cap and mirror lifted, under even light

risks.risk: Autofocus, buttons, dials, or metering may be faulty
risks.proof: Short video showing power-on, AF lock beep, dial changes, and shutter fire
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed working, worst case non-functional

risks.risk: LCD screen could be cracked, dim, or have dead pixels
risks.proof: Photo of the rear LCD powered on showing a live image or menu
risks.if_unproven: priced as screen condition unknown/possibly damaged

risks.risk: Lens mount pins or internal mirror could be bent or damaged
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the mount ring and mirror box from the front

risks.risk: Claimed accessories (2 batteries, silicone case, charger) may not actually be included
risks.proof: Photo of all accessories laid out together with the camera and box

risks.risk: No lens is evidenced despite seller referencing 'the lens'
risks.proof: Photo of any lens intended for sale, with glass and mount visible
risks.if_unproven: priced as body-only, no lens included

proof_requests: Photo of in-camera shutter count screen or a fresh test-shot's EXIF data
Video of power-on, autofocus operation, dial/button use, and shutter firing
Close-up photo of sensor (mirror up) and lens mount/pins
Photo of LCD screen powered on
Photo of all included accessories (batteries, charger, case) laid out with the camera
Clarify and photograph any lens if one is actually included
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a Nikon D7100 body with no lens, caps on, and no visible accessories, so it can be priced as a body-only, unverified-condition unit at worst case pending the listed proofs.
